title: Light Dutch Soya Bean Flatbread
description: A buttery and flaky Dutch flatbread featuring soya bean, infused oil, and low-carb friendly ingredients, perfect for a light meal or snack on a tagliere.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soya bean flour, almond flour, and salt.
Add the infused oil, melted butter, egg, black pepper, and dried parsley to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they are lightly golden brown.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Serve the flatbreads warm on a tagliere, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
